# `ObjectState` — engine binding surface

- **`ObjectState`** — retail table VA `0x00B995B0`, 9 required cfuncs.

**GENERATED — do not edit by hand.** Regenerate with `cargo run -p mercs2_script --bin emmylua-gen`.

For IDE autocomplete on the same surface, load the paired EmmyLua stub — see `output/emmylua/mercs2/ObjectState.lua` (regenerated by the same command).

## Bindings

9 bindings on this global. `Corpus` = distinct references to the binding across the decompiled shipped Lua (both `docs/mercs2-luacd/` and `docs/mercs2-dlc-luacd/src/`); `0` means no shipped script calls it, which is a hint that a novel one may not have an established idiom to follow.
